comment:
* Handles argument parsing for args related to the zygote spawner. * * Current recognized args: *
    *
  • --setuid=uid of child process, defaults to 0 *
  • --setgid=gid of child process, defaults to 0 *
  • --setgroups=comma-separated list of supplimentary gid's *
  • --capabilities=a pair of comma-separated integer strings * indicating Linux capabilities(2) set for child. The first string * represents the permitted set, and the second the * effective set. Precede each with 0 or * 0x for octal or hexidecimal value. If unspecified, both default to 0. * This parameter is only applied if the uid of the new process will * be non-0. *
  • --rlimit=r,c,mtuple of values for setrlimit() call. * r is the resource, c and m * are the settings for current and max value. *
  • --instruction-set=instruction-set-string which instruction set to use/emulate. *
  • --nice-name=nice name to appear in ps *
  • --package-name=package name this process belongs to *
  • --runtime-args indicates that the remaining arg list should * be handed off to com.android.internal.os.RuntimeInit, rather than * processed directly. * Android runtime startup (eg, Binder initialization) is also eschewed. *
  • [--] <args for RuntimeInit > *

variables.name: mUid
variables.comment: * from --setuid

variables.name: mGid
variables.comment: * from --setgid

variables.name: mGids
variables.comment: * from --setgroups

variables.name: mRuntimeFlags
variables.comment: * From --runtime-flags.

variables.name: mMountExternal
variables.comment: * From --mount-external

variables.name: mTargetSdkVersionSpecified
variables.comment: * from --target-sdk-version.

variables.name: mNiceName
variables.comment: * from --nice-name

variables.name: mCapabilitiesSpecified
variables.comment: * from --capabilities

variables.name: mSeInfoSpecified
variables.comment: * from --seinfo

variables.name: mRLimits
variables.comment: * from all --rlimit=r,c,m

variables.name: mInvokeWith
variables.comment: * from --invoke-with

variables.name: mPackageName
variables.comment: from --package-name

variables.name: mRemainingArgs
variables.comment: * Any args after and including the first non-option arg (or after a '--')

variables.name: mAbiListQuery
variables.comment: * Whether the current arguments constitute an ABI list query.

variables.name: mInstructionSet
variables.comment: * The instruction set to use, or null when not important.

variables.name: mAppDataDir
variables.comment:
* The app data directory. May be null, e.g., for the system server. Note that this might not be
     * reliable in the case of process-sharing apps.

variables.name: mPreloadPackage
variables.comment: * The APK path of the package to preload, when using --preload-package.

variables.name: mPreloadApp
variables.comment:
* A Base64 string representing a serialize ApplicationInfo Parcel,
     when using --preload-app.

variables.name: mPreloadPackageLibs
variables.comment: * The native library path of the package to preload, when using --preload-package.

variables.name: mPreloadPackageLibFileName
variables.comment: * The filename of the native library to preload, when using --preload-package.

variables.name: mPreloadPackageCacheKey
variables.comment:
* The cache key under which to enter the preloaded package into the classloader cache, when
     * using --preload-package.

variables.name: mPreloadDefault
variables.comment:
* Whether this is a request to start preloading the default resources and classes. This
     * argument only makes sense when the zygote is in lazy preload mode (i.e, when it's started
     * with --enable-lazy-preload).

variables.name: mStartChildZygote
variables.comment:
* Whether this is a request to start a zygote process as a child of this zygote. Set with
     * --start-child-zygote. The remaining arguments must include the CHILD_ZYGOTE_SOCKET_NAME_ARG
     * flag to indicate the abstract socket name that should be used for communication.

variables.name: mPidQuery
variables.comment: * Whether the current arguments constitute a request for the zygote's PID.

variables.name: mBootCompleted
variables.comment: * Whether the current arguments constitute a notification that boot completed.

variables.name: mApiDenylistExemptions
variables.comment:
* Exemptions from API deny-listing. These are sent to the pre-forked zygote at boot time, or
     * when they change, via --set-api-denylist-exemptions.

variables.name: mHiddenApiAccessLogSampleRate
variables.comment:
* Sampling rate for logging hidden API accesses to the event log. This is sent to the
     * pre-forked zygote at boot time, or when it changes, via --hidden-api-log-sampling-rate.

variables.name: mHiddenApiAccessStatslogSampleRate
variables.comment:
* Sampling rate for logging hidden API accesses to statslog. This is sent to the
     * pre-forked zygote at boot time, or when it changes, via --hidden-api-statslog-sampling-rate.

variables.name: mIsTopApp
variables.comment: * @see Zygote#START_AS_TOP_APP_ARG

variables.name: mDisabledCompatChanges
variables.comment:
* A set of disabled app compatibility changes for the running app. From
     * --disabled-compat-changes.

variables.name: mPkgDataInfoList
variables.comment:
* A list that stores all related packages and its data info: volume uuid and inode.
     * Null if it does need to do app data isolation.

variables.name: mAllowlistedDataInfoList
variables.comment:
* A list that stores all allowlisted app data info: volume uuid and inode.
     * Null if it does need to do app data isolation.

variables.name: mBindMountAppStorageDirs
variables.comment: * @see Zygote#BIND_MOUNT_APP_STORAGE_DIRS

variables.name: mBindMountAppDataDirs
variables.comment: * @see Zygote#BIND_MOUNT_APP_DATA_DIRS

variables.name: mBindMountSyspropOverrides
variables.comment: * @see Zygote#BIND_MOUNT_SYSPROP_OVERRIDES

methods.name: public static ZygoteArguments getInstance(ZygoteCommandBuffer args) throws IllegalArgumentException, EOFException
methods.comment:
* Return a new ZygoteArguments reflecting the contents of the given ZygoteCommandBuffer. Return
     * null if the ZygoteCommandBuffer was positioned at EOF. Assumes the buffer is initially
     * positioned at the beginning of the command.

methods.name: private void parseArgs(ZygoteCommandBuffer args, int argCount) throws IllegalArgumentException, EOFException
methods.comment:
* Parses the commandline arguments intended for the Zygote spawner (such as "--setuid=" and
     * "--setgid=") and creates an array containing the remaining args. Return false if we were
     * at EOF.
     *
     * Per security review bug #1112214, duplicate args are disallowed in critical cases to make
     * injection harder.

methodNames: public static ZygoteArguments getInstance(ZygoteCommandBuffer args) throws IllegalArgumentException, EOFException
private void parseArgs(ZygoteCommandBuffer args, int argCount) throws IllegalArgumentException, EOFException
